description: Generic teaching/design loop: decompose any artifact or concept into sections, explain each in a fixed plain-English format grounded in the user's actual repos, one section per turn, recording settled decisions into a ledger that feeds /design. One-shot explain mode included.

requirements.depth: plain default, --terse flag, mid-loop verbal dials
requirements.ledger: durable file at docs/walkthroughs/, handoff to /design offered at exit
requirements.composability: v1 standalone; per-iteration contract specced for later /design integration
